wiki.title: Chris Pappas (American politician)
wiki.extract: Christopher Charles Pappas ( PAPP-əss; born June 4, 1980) is an American politician who has served as the U.S. representative from New Hampshire's 1st congressional district since 2019. A member of the Democratic Party, Pappas served on the New Hampshire Executive Council from 2013 to 2019.
